metadata.title: High-Performance Computing Data Protection

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and appropriate use of data processed and produced by shared high-performance computing platforms.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: HPC shared filesystems, scratch storage, burst buffers, high-throughput data paths, and research data repositories.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing data protection, lifecycle control, and access boundaries in high-performance computing environments.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: HPC data protection assumes foundational trust in shared compute platforms.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Data protection relies on correct attribution and authorization of HPC users and jobs.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Credential and access abuse leading to unauthorized access to shared HPC data stores.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Lateral movement through shared filesystems or data paths in HPC environments.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Collection of sensitive or proprietary research data from shared storage.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Data from local system collection via access to shared HPC storage.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Data transfer through shared networked storage or intermediate buffers.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Data access control enforcement on shared storage resources.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Encryption or protection of data at rest within shared filesystems.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Data lifecycle management to remove or protect residual data after job completion.

metadata.remarks: High-Performance Computing Data Protection defines the trust properties required to protect data within shared, performance-oriented computing environments. This pattern makes data access boundaries, lifecycle risks, and high-volume data movement explicit, recognizing that HPC platforms prioritize throughput and collaboration over default data isolation.

components.title: Shared Storage Access Control
components.description: Controls access to shared HPC filesystems and data repositories.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access to shared storage resources is limited to authorized users and workloads.

components.title: Job Data Isolation
components.description: Separates data used or produced by concurrent HPC jobs.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Data generated or consumed by HPC jobs is isolated to prevent unintended cross-job access.

components.title: Data Lifecycle and Residual Risk Management
components.description: Manages data persistence, cleanup, and residual risk after HPC job completion.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Residual data risks are addressed through lifecycle management of HPC data.
